summary: Backend + frontend tested for Founder Campaign + Admin panel + Free-tier gating. 13/14 backend tests pass. Only bug: /api/decisions (and /api/decisions/act) is NOT gated by premium_user — returns 200 for free users, contradicting the spec that says /decisions must return 402. All other premium endpoints (chat/sessions, valuation, report, health-index, future, investment-grade, POST /chat) correctly return 402; ceo-daily & signals return premium_locked=true for free users; admin has full access. Admin auth (403 non-admin / 200 admin) correct on all /admin/* endpoints. Founder checkout guards work: enterprise=400, founder_closed=409 when campaign toggled off. Professional trial checkout creates a valid Stripe URL. Frontend: Pricing page shows plan-founder/professional/enterprise with correct testids and prices; Enterprise CTA navigates to /contacto; FAQ accordion toggles. Admin page loads, all 5 tabs switch, filter-* + admin-search present, toggle-campaign-btn flips campaign, StickyNote → note-input → save-note-btn saves a note. Free user (fresh registration): sidebar nav-saude/valor/ceo/relatorios/conselhos/futuro all show lock icon; clicking nav-saude routes to /planos; direct visits /saude, /valor, /futuro, /relatorios, /conselhos, /ceo all render data-testid=upgrade-wall; /admin as free user redirects to /. Painel LockedBlock (premium-locked-block) visually confirmed in screenshot on '/'. Full end-to-end Stripe payment (card 4242) was NOT executed because Stripe-hosted checkout page automation is fragile in this environment; the checkout URL creation and guard logic are covered.

critical.issue: Uses Depends(get_current_user) instead of premium_user — free users get 200 instead of 402. Spec requires 402 for free tier. Fix: change dependency in /app/backend/routers/ceo.py line 114 (and /decisions/act at line 146) to Depends(premium_user).

action_items: Change /api/decisions and /api/decisions/act to use Depends(premium_user) in /app/backend/routers/ceo.py so free tier receives 402 (matches spec and matches UpgradeWall behaviour of the /conselhos page which currently would show data instead of the wall for the free tier via API).

OPTIONAL: main agent should run an interactive end-to-end Stripe test with card 4242 4242 4242 4242 to confirm the founder_number allocation increments claimed by exactly 1 and that trialing subscriptions do NOT increment claimed — the guard logic is verified but the full paid-flow was not executed in this test iteration.
critical_code_review_comments: routers/ceo.py: /decisions and /decisions/act are missing premium gating (see backend_issues.critical).

routers/billing.py get_status: fallback runs sync_subscription only after checkout completion — good redundancy against webhook. However it does not verify session.metadata.user_id == record.user_id before syncing, relying on record.user_id — acceptable but a stricter equality check would harden against tampering.

core.py handle_founder_activation: atomic increment via findOneAndUpdate {seq: {$lt: FOUNDER_LIMIT}} and per-user lock — correct. Trial subscriptions correctly avoid founder allocation because sync_subscription only assigns when status == 'active' (not 'trialing') — verify by inspection.
Pricing.jsx founder-progress: inner filler div may have width 0 while claimed=0 causing Playwright is_visible=false; consider min-width for a small marker so QA/UX shows the bar exists even at 0.

rca_of_the_issue: /api/decisions router uses Depends(get_current_user) rather than Depends(premium_user). Reproduction: register a free user, GET /api/decisions with the auth cookie — response is 200 with verdict/decisions payload. Expected 402 premium_required. Mitigation: swap the dependency to premium_user (already used correctly by /valuation, /report, /health-index, /chat, /chat/sessions). No DB migration or data changes required.
